for receiver,ptrpos,pragma in itertools.product(['w','a','b','t','m','slot','dim','unused'],['before','after'],['life','cse','default']):
 if receiver in ['m','dim'] and ptrpos=='after':continue

 pre='    p = bg + m;\n' if ptrpos=='before' else ''

 body+=('    p = bg + m;\n' if ptrpos=='after' else '')
 body+='    '+r+' = (unsigned int)'+r+' << 28;\n    hi = (unsigned int)'+r+' >> 16;\n'
 s=s[:start]+body+s[end:]
 if receiver!='w':s=s.replace('    unsigned int w;','')
 s=s.replace('#pragma opt_lifetimes off',{'life':'#pragma opt_lifetimes off','cse':'#pragma opt_common_subs off','default':''}[pragma])

import itertools
from probe_lib import *
fam='cursor-tileword-history'
seed=(OUT/'paint-cursor-object-result-inplace-life.cpp').read_text()
for pos,span,pragma in itertools.product(['entry','before-dim','before-shift','before-store'],['load','masked','packed'],['life','default']):
 s=seed.replace('hi=w>>16;\nint i;','hi=w>>16;')
 # Reuse the scalar first-word temporary as the subsequent column counter.
 statement='int i=p[0x20];' if span=='load' else 'int i=p[0x20] & 0xfff;'
 if span=='packed':statement='int i=(p[0x20] & 0xfff) | hi;'
 if span=='packed' and pos!='before-store':continue
 marker={'entry':'unsigned int hi =','before-dim':'if(dim != 0)','before-shift':'hi <<=28;','before-store':'    p[0x20] ='}[pos]
 s=s.replace(marker,statement+'\n'+marker,1)
 old='p[0x20] = (unsigned short)((p[0x20] & 0xfff) | hi);'
 rhs='(i & 0xfff) | hi' if span=='load' else 'i | hi' if span=='masked' else 'i'
 s=s.replace(old,'p[0x20] = (unsigned short)('+rhs+');')
 s=s.replace('#pragma opt_lifetimes off','#pragma opt_lifetimes off' if pragma=='life' else '')
 test('cursor-tileword-'+pos+'-'+span+'-'+pragma,s,fam)
# Identical first-load history outside helper with a truthful by-reference counter.
for pos in ['entry','before-dim','before-shift']:
 s=seed.replace('Paint(int value, int dim)','Paint(int value, int dim, int &i)').replace('hi=w>>16;\nint i;','hi=w>>16;').replace('cursor.Paint(a, dim)','cursor.Paint(a, dim, a)')
 marker={'entry':'unsigned int hi =','before-dim':'if(dim != 0)','before-shift':'hi <<=28;'}[pos]
 s=s.replace(marker,'i = p[0x20];\n'+marker,1).replace('p[0x20] = (unsigned short)((p[0x20] & 0xfff) | hi);','p[0x20] = (unsigned short)((i & 0xfff) | hi);')
 test('cursor-tileword-ref-'+pos,s,fam)
report(fam)
